svg.title: What moving up bought: trials vs real switchers
svg.desc: Average weight loss. Randomized trials where people started on the stronger option from day one, 72 weeks: semaglutide 2.4 mg 15.6% vs 7.2 mg 18.7% (STEP UP); semaglutide 13.7% vs tirzepatide 20.2% (SURMOUNT-5). Real patients who switched from semaglutide to tirzepatide at Weill Cornell, 6 months later: 8.1% more lost if they switched at a plateau (28 people), 2.9% if semaglutide never worked for them (33 people). No trial has tested retatrutide in people switching from semaglutide or tirzepatide.
